content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a signedness error introduced in a previous commit (599b800b). The function `NET_SetOOBHeader` was being called with a string argument that was not explicitly cast to the correct pointer type, leading to potential issues with how the data was interpreted. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the string is cast to a `char *` type before being passed to the function, which resolves the signedness mismatch and ensures proper handling of the data.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a signedness error introduced in a previous commit (599b800b). The function `NET_SetOOBHeader` was being called with a string argument that was not explicitly cast to the correct pointer type, leading to potential issues with how the data was interpreted. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the string is cast to a `char *` type before being passed to the function, which resolves the signedness mismatch and ensures proper handling of the data.
Patch:
From 3f2f169672e36e910635a4c6e27307250860b406 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Qrntz <qrntz@lavabit.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jan 2013 15:38:43 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Fix signedness error introduced by 599b800b, also fix
 spacing.

---
 src/engine/qcommon/net_chan.c | 6 +++---
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/engine/qcommon/net_chan.c b/src/engine/qcommon/net_chan.c
index 1f28fc973..b7476f758 100644
--- a/src/engine/qcommon/net_chan.c
+++ b/src/engine/qcommon/net_chan.c
@@ -735,7 +735,7 @@ void QDECL PRINTF_LIKE(3) NET_OutOfBandPrint( netsrc_t sock, netadr_t adr, const
 	va_list argptr;
 	char    string[ MAX_MSGLEN ];
 
-	NET_SetOOBHeader(string);
+	NET_SetOOBHeader( string );
 
 	va_start( argptr, format );
 	Q_vsnprintf( string + 4, sizeof( string ) - 4, format, argptr );
@@ -747,7 +747,7 @@ void QDECL PRINTF_LIKE(3) NET_OutOfBandPrint( netsrc_t sock, netadr_t adr, const
 
 /*
 ===============
-NET_OutOfBandPrint
+NET_OutOfBandData
 
 Sends a data message in an out-of-band datagram (only used for "connect")
 ================
@@ -758,7 +758,7 @@ void QDECL NET_OutOfBandData( netsrc_t sock, netadr_t adr, byte *format, int len
 	int   i;
 	msg_t mbuf;
 
-	NET_SetOOBHeader(string);
+	NET_SetOOBHeader( ( char * ) string );
 
 	for ( i = 0; i < len; i++ )
 	{
